answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 7 graders each stake 60 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. A marble that can be verified, a reef that can be measured, and a lagoon that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
